```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(gtsummary)
library(flextable)
library(here)

here::i_am("scripts/s5_table1_descriptive.Rmd")
```

```{r load-data}
df <- read_csv(here("outputs", "s3", "v2_1_blue_with_SMM.csv"),
               show_col_types = FALSE)

message("Loaded: ", nrow(df), " rows x ", ncol(df), " cols")
```

```{r prepare-variables}
df_table <- df %>%
  mutate(

    # ── Outcome ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    SMM = factor(SMM, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No SMM", "SMM")),

    # ── ORDINAL variables ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    AgeCat_V1 = factor(AgeCat_V1,
                       levels  = 1:4,
                       labels  = c("13-17", "18-34", "35-39", ">=40"),
                       ordered = TRUE),

    Education = factor(Education,
                       levels  = 1:6,
                       labels  = c("Less than HS", "HS grad/GED",
                                   "Some college", "Assoc/Tech degree",
                                   "Completed college", "Beyond college"),
                       ordered = TRUE),

    V1AF10 = factor(V1AF10,
                    levels  = 1:4,
                    labels  = c("Very well", "Well", "Not well", "Not at all"),
                    ordered = TRUE),

    GravCat = factor(GravCat,
                     levels  = 1:3,
                     labels  = c("1", "2", ">=3"),
                     ordered = TRUE),

    # ── NON-ORDINAL >3 categories: reconstruct from one-hot for display ──

    Race = case_when(
      Race_2 == 1 ~ "Hispanic or Latino",
      Race_3 == 1 ~ "Non-Hispanic Black",
      Race_4 == 1 ~ "Non-Hispanic Asian",
      Race_5 == 1 ~ "Non-Hispanic AIAN",
      Race_6 == 1 ~ "Non-Hispanic NHOPI",
      Race_7 == 1 ~ "Non-Hispanic Mixed",
      Race_8 == 1 ~ "Non-Hispanic Other",
      Race_9 == 1 ~ "Unknown/Not reported",
      TRUE        ~ "Non-Hispanic White"
    ) %>% factor(),

    Marital_Status = case_when(
      Marital_2 == 1 ~ "Divorced",
      Marital_3 == 1 ~ "Separated",
      Marital_4 == 1 ~ "Widowed",
      Marital_5 == 1 ~ "Never married",
      TRUE           ~ "Married/Living with partner"
    ) %>% factor(),

    # ── BINARY (0/1) variables ────────────────────────────────────────
    # All already 0/1 after s1/s3 processing (missing = No applied)

    Ins                   = factor(Ins,       levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    ChronHTN              = factor(ChronHTN,  levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    Diabetes              = factor(Diabetes,  levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    VXXB01ab_FA           = factor(VXXB01ab_FA,  levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    Sleep_Apnea           = factor(Sleep_Apnea,  levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    VXXB01al_FA           = factor(VXXB01al_FA,  levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    Cardiac_Disease       = factor(Cardiac_Disease,    levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    Autoimmune_Disease    = factor(Autoimmune_Disease,  levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    VXXB01ac_FA           = factor(VXXB01ac_FA,  levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    Thyroid_Disorder      = factor(Thyroid_Disorder,   levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    Prior_Uterine_Surgery = factor(Prior_Uterine_Surgery, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    VXXB01ap_FA           = factor(VXXB01ap_FA,  levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    Bleeding_Disorder     = factor(Bleeding_Disorder,  levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    VXXB01ar_FA           = factor(VXXB01ar_FA,  levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    CMDA04a               = factor(CMDA04a,  levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    CMDA04b               = factor(CMDA04b,  levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    CMBG01                = factor(CMBG01,   levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    A09A03b3              = factor(A09A03b3, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    Tobacco_Use           = factor(Tobacco_Use,  levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    Alcohol_Use           = factor(Alcohol_Use,  levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    Drug_Use              = factor(Drug_Use,     levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes"))
  )
```

```{r table1}
# Variables in display order, grouped by domain
table1_vars <- c(
  # Sociodemographic / SDoH
  "AgeCat_V1", "Education", "Race", "Marital_Status",
  "V1AF10", "V1AF09", "GravCat", "Ins",

  # Baseline Medical History
  "ChronHTN", "Diabetes", "VXXB01ab_FA", "Sleep_Apnea",
  "VXXB01al_FA", "Cardiac_Disease", "Autoimmune_Disease",
  "VXXB01ac_FA", "Thyroid_Disorder", "Prior_Uterine_Surgery",
  "VXXB01ap_FA", "Bleeding_Disorder", "VXXB01ar_FA",

  # Late Pregnancy Clinical Status
  "BMI", "CMAC03_wks",
  "V3BA02a1", "V3BA02b1",
  "CMAH01b4", "CMAH01b6", "CMAH01b1",
  "CMDA04a", "CMDA04b", "CMBG01", "A09A03b3",

  # Behavioral
  "Tobacco_Use", "Alcohol_Use", "Drug_Use"
)

# Display labels matching expert codebook
var_labels <- list(
  AgeCat_V1      ~ "Maternal age category (years)",
  Education      ~ "Education status",
  Race           ~ "Race/Ethnicity",
  Marital_Status ~ "Marital status",
  V1AF10         ~ "English proficiency",
  V1AF09         ~ "Years lived in U.S.",
  GravCat        ~ "Gravidity",
  Ins            ~ "Any insurance",
  ChronHTN              ~ "Chronic hypertension",
  Diabetes              ~ "Diabetes",
  VXXB01ab_FA           ~ "Asthma",
  Sleep_Apnea           ~ "Sleep apnea / CPAP use",
  VXXB01al_FA           ~ "Renal disease",
  Cardiac_Disease       ~ "Cardiac disease",
  Autoimmune_Disease    ~ "Autoimmune disease",
  VXXB01ac_FA           ~ "Seizure disorder",
  Thyroid_Disorder      ~ "Thyroid disorder",
  Prior_Uterine_Surgery ~ "Prior uterine surgery",
  VXXB01ap_FA           ~ "Thrombocytopenia history",
  Bleeding_Disorder     ~ "Bleeding disorder",
  VXXB01ar_FA           ~ "History of blood clots / stroke",
  BMI        ~ "BMI (kg/m\u00b2)",
  CMAC03_wks ~ "Gestational age at delivery (weeks)",
  V3BA02a1   ~ "Last prenatal systolic BP (mmHg)",
  V3BA02b1   ~ "Last prenatal diastolic BP (mmHg)",
  CMAH01b4   ~ "Hematocrit (%)",
  CMAH01b6   ~ "Platelet count (\u00d710\u00b3/\u00b5L)",
  CMAH01b1   ~ "WBC count (\u00d710\u00b3/\u00b5L)",
  CMDA04a    ~ "New-onset hypertensive disorder (\u226520 wks)",
  CMDA04b    ~ "New-onset isolated proteinuria (\u226520 wks)",
  CMBG01     ~ "Cerclage placed",
  A09A03b3   ~ "Suspected preeclampsia / HELLP / eclampsia",
  Tobacco_Use ~ "Tobacco use",
  Alcohol_Use ~ "Alcohol use",
  Drug_Use    ~ "Drug use"
)

# Overall Table 1 (no stratification)
table1 <- df_table %>%
  select(all_of(table1_vars)) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    label     = var_labels,
    missing   = "ifany",
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous()  ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = list(
      all_continuous()  ~ 2,
      all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1)
    )
  ) %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 1. Descriptive Statistics of Study Sample**") %>%
  modify_footnote(
    all_stat_cols() ~
      "Continuous: Mean (SD); Categorical: n (%); Missing reported if present"
  )

table1
```

```{r export}
dir.create(here("outputs", "s5"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

out_path <- here("outputs", "s5", "Table1_descriptive_statistics.docx")

table1 %>%
  as_flex_table() %>%
  flextable::save_as_docx(path = out_path)

message("Saved: ", out_path)
```
